<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex087042026-02-2316-03-16" status="unreviewed">sel byed la'ang nges pa blo'i | brjod pa'i sgra'i brjod bya don gyi bsal ba ste gsum yod pa la 
         <lb edRef="inst:5293" n="50a5"/> dang po ni sgra mi rtag rtogs kyi rjes dpag lta bu | 
         gnyis pa ni sgra mi rtag ces pa'i <expan>tshig gsum</expan> pa ni de dag gi yul sgra mi rtag pa'o ||
         de la <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3846">'u yug</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3846">kha cig</rs> ni snga ma gcig mtshan nyid pa phyi ma gnyis btags pa bar 'dod la | 
         <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:6828">gzhan dag</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6828">byams</rs></note> ni phyi ma gcig mtshan nyid par 'dod do ||</seg></TEI>
